environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule 'block-union-encoding' with RegexPatternSet matching '(?i)(union\s*(all\s*)?select|%75%6e%69%6f%6e|u]n[i]o[n|/\*.*\*/)', field=AllQueryArgs, text transformation sequence=[URL_DECODE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, LOWERCASE, COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE], action=BLOCK, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default BLOCK action. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm rule group evaluation order is Priority 1→2→3 with no early termination on COUNT actions.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association
